storage.darkspawn.refresh_hint: Apply search and refresh the item list. Newly arriving types appear on refresh.
storage.darkspawn.tab_hint: Switch between stored items and recoverable trash.
storage.darkspawn.deposit_hint: Deposit main inventory. Keep hotbar, armor, and offhand.
storage.darkspawn.resort_hint: Send stored items to matching chests on the connected Dump route. Trash is left untouched.
storage.darkspawn.trash_hint: Click twice within five seconds to permanently delete this Bank's trash. New arrivals cancel confirmation.
storage.darkspawn.upgrade_cost: Upgrade costs %s diamond block(s). Maximum: 2,048 variants.
storage.darkspawn.dump_hint: Deposit here to feed your sorting route.
storage.darkspawn.ghost_hint: Click with an item to set. Right-click to clear. No items consumed.
storage.darkspawn.trash_filter_hint: Overflow matching this item enters Trash. Click to set; right-click to clear.
storage.darkspawn.withdraw_detail: Left: stack. Right: one. Shift-click: fill inventory.
storage.darkspawn.bank_item_hint: Stored + trash: %s items; level %s. Contents travel with this block.
storage.darkspawn.block_hint: Gold arrow = output. Empty-hand use opens; sneak-use rotates.
storage.darkspawn.tube_hint: Gold arrow = output. Empty-hand use rotates. Follows up to 128 loaded blocks.
storage.darkspawn.sort_chest_hint: Combine compatible stacks and sort all 27 chest slots by item ID.
